summary: Deduplicated discussion signals about agent runtimes, eval, memory security, bank access restrictions, and recent product releases (OpenShell, Gemini, OpenHands). | Vendor-only screening: mix of high-priority security advisories, platform releases (OpenAI, Cloudflare, JetBrains, OpenRouter), and operator case studies (AWS, Supabase). Top signals: OpenAI Decisions API and multiple GHSA advisories affecting MCP/vector-store tooling. | GitHub snapshot shows heavy activity in agent platforms (LangFlow, Dify, Rocketride, BrowserOS), multiple vendor releases (Cloudflare, Microsoft, Vercel), and rising infra primitives (agent sandboxes, MCP memory). No social/discussion field reports in this shard — need external user threads for operator workflows and adoption signals. | Package-release scan (PyPI/npm/crates/open-vsx/docker) surfaced several agent infra primitives and a few high-download vendor extensions; missing operator/social reports for field workflows.
